F25 2023-06-30 is the fund's only F25 failure (value 0.3979). Published holdings 403,510,457 -> 615,303,176 (+52.5 pct) equal the printed Total Debt Investments; published total assets 692,689k -> 780,612k (+12.7 pct). Printed Total Investments including the Treasury bill and money fund 686,157,510 -> 772,888,903 (+12.6 pct), so the gap is cash deployed into loans. Caveat recorded, not a rejection: the T-bill and money-fund lines are not published even as CASH rows for this fund (report not_done); F25 sums all holdings rows, so the finding exists partly because those cash rows are absent. Under owner ruling D-202 (1a) such rows stay out of published fair value either way.

Coverage is right (F27 FAIL 2024-09-30, value 2.6568; F27 fails only 2024-09-30, 2024-12-31, 2025-12-31). Reviewer reproduced the WAC 12.32 and rated share 1.0. The mechanism does not hold on the printed figures. Printed nine months 2024: interest 92,053 + PIK 7,171 = 99,224k, annualised 132.3M on average investments about 849M = 15.6 pct asset income yield, about 3.3 points above the 12.32 coupon before any leverage. Levered coupon less printed costs: 12.32 x 1.67 = 20.6 pct of net assets, less expenses 44,708k annualised (59.6M) over average net assets about 508M = 11.7 pct, gives about 8.9 pct against the printed 14.98. 'Leverage less interest cost' therefore leaves about 6 points unexplained; the gap sits at asset level (income above coupon: OID or prepayment accretion, rate timing, or published coupons too low), and none of those was tested. The report also cites interest cost without a figure; published interest_expense for this quarter is 64,000 against the printed 'Interest and credit facility expenses 9,831' thousand (64 is the printed directors' fees line), a separate field error not recorded anywhere. Same standard as the NMF SLF I r2 review (D-204). Missing evidence: a reconciliation of printed interest income to coupon x average par (accretion, fees, timing) or proof that published coupons are wrong.

The detection decision is what fails: existing_detector, yet the observation says 'no rule fires today', and the reference is an observation record, not a rule or proposal.
